title: Resolution urging Albany to require warning labels on anti-aging skincare
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Assembly to pass A.10829 and the Governor to sign S.8598A/A.10829, which would require certain anti-aging skin care products to carry a clear warning label about ingredients that may cause skin irritation, sun sensitivity or other reactions, especially in people under 18. The affected ingredients include retinoids, alpha hydroxy acids, salicylic acid, DMDM hydantoin, quaternium-15, oxybenzone, octinoxate and talc. The resolution cites concerns about young children and teens buying adult anti-aging products marketed through social media and retailers.
